eligibility.quote: Since ArduPlane-3.7.0, mode 14, previously assigned to LAND, has changed to AVOID_ADSB. ... This does not match the stringify for ArduPlane in mavros lib, for both [ROS2](https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/blob/ros2/mavros/src/lib/uas_stringify.cpp#L49) and [ROS1](https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/blob/1.20.1/mavros/src/lib/uas_stringify.cpp#L45), and could result in unwanted behaviors if the user asks for LAND mode using mavros, which would translate to a request for the flight controller to change to AVOID_ADSB mode.
